payload.summary: Multi-team cross-session orchestration — four phases. P1: thread CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID as owner_client_session into task_locks; rebind heartbeat/release matching ladder; delete self-held-heartbeat anti-pattern; CLAUDE.md step 2.5 PRE-CLAIM gate. P1.5: server-side reaper in gcExpiredLocks + 600s periodic timer; emit orphan-signal before GC-delete; router step 2.5 + dev-team Step 0a adoption probe; resume from checkpoint (not zero); poison-task escalation after N_MAX=3 re-dispatches. P2: presence registry via session-presence enum. P3: fire-time cron leader election.
po_decisions_required: P1 scope + sequencing before code lands
P1.5 honest-bound acceptance: adoptable-not-self-healing for all-dead-sessions case
P1.5 N_MAX=3 poison-task threshold (or configure per task_kind)
P3 standing decision: supersede manual single-cowork-owner convention
p1_tasks: P1-MCP-1: migration SQL — ADD COLUMN owner_client_session TEXT (nullable, NOT UNIQUE)
P1-MCP-2: coordinationStore.ts matching-ladder rebind + release {ok,released} return shape
P1-MCP-3: coordinationTools.ts add owner_client_session param; stop server-side injection
P1-AF-2: dispatch-claim SKILL lift to router scope + namespace canonicalization
P1-AF-4: task-lock SKILL rebind authoritative key to owner_client_session
p15_tasks: P1.5-MCP-1: migration SQL — orphan-signal enum + ADD COLUMN redispatch_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0
P1.5-MCP-2: gcExpiredLocks pre-GC emit: scan expired rows (grace+300s), INSERT orphan-signal row, then DELETE original
P1.5-MCP-3: server-side periodic reaper timer (setInterval 600s) in mcp-server startup
P1.5-MCP-4: task_list_held — add owner_agent filter param + redispatch_count in output schema
P1.5-AF-1: router step 2.5 adoption probe (task_list_held orphan-signal + claim + checkpoint resume + N_MAX escalation + BUG telegram)
P1.5-AF-2: dev-team Step 0a — sprint-task orphan adoption + orch-state board flip via scripts/orch-apply.sh (Zod tri-point)
p2_tasks: P2-MCP-1: session-presence enum + task_list_held output fields (owner_client_session + payload)
P2-AF-1: roster read wired into router step 2.5
sequencing_constraints: P1 before P1.5 (owner_client_session must be in lock rows before orphan-signal payload is useful)
P1.5 and P2 can run in parallel after P1
